findings.title: Alleged Member of "8-Digits Team" Ransomware Group Extradited from Italy for Role in Major Data Extortion Campaign Against U.S. Hospitals, Healthcare Entities, and Schools
findings.summary_md: The Justice Department announced that Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, a Kazak national, made his initial appearance in Knoxville federal court after extradition from Italy. The indictment alleges he was a member of the 8-Digits Team, affiliated with INC and Lynx ransomware, and that co-conspirators targeted victims in at least six states, exfiltrated data, then demanded payment in exchange for promises not to publish it. DOJ quotes the conspirators claiming more than 50 terabytes of data and over 70 million confidential health records, with over $500 million in ransom demands. He faces five charges with a maximum penalty of 27 years; the release credits Italian, Ukrainian and Lithuanian authorities with assisting the arrest and extradition.

findings.title: Man extradited to U.S. over ransomware campaign targeting hospitals and schools
findings.summary_md: 2 News Nevada reported on November 16 that Roman Khlynovskiy appeared in federal court in Knoxville after extradition from Italy, citing the Justice Department. The article says prosecutors tied him to the 8-Digits Team and its INC and Lynx affiliations, with alleged victims among hospitals, schools and other healthcare entities. It states that the states involved were not identified. The report repeats court document claims of more than 50 terabytes of stolen data, over 70 million confidential health records and more than $500 million in ransom demands.

findings.title: Roman Khlynovskiy, Alleged Member of 8-Digits Team Ransomware Group Extradited for Role in Major Data Extortion Campaign Against U.S. Hospitals, Healthcare Entities, and Schools
findings.summary_md: DataBreaches.Net published this report at 00:30:50 UTC on November 17, ahead of the story's first_seen timestamp. It says Roman Khlynovskiy, 43, made his initial appearance in Knoxville after extradition from Italy and quotes the Justice Department describing one of the largest healthcare data breaches in decades. The feed classifies the post under health data, education sector, 8-Digits Team and Roman Khlynovskiy. Its excerpt relies on court documents describing network access, data exfiltration and threats to publish stolen records.
